verdicts.reason: A reflows the headline to four large lines that fill the portrait canvas with clear hierarchy over the CTA. Its flaws are minor: 'Bubbles,' sits alone on line one, and the block sits low, with about 170px of space above it but only about 50px below the CTA. B keeps the landscape two-line wrap, so the headline is small and nearly touches the side edges (about 35px margins) while large empty bands sit above and below. Its CTA is also jammed tight under the headline, so B looks like the banner dropped onto a taller canvas rather than a real reflow.
